'''Primitive Reekers''', known internally as '''Nogla''', is a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the [[Evolution System]].
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 2|Ubiquitous Development Level 2]] through [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Level 4]], with a spawnweight of 15.
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 10.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawned by 4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored into a [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV Dispatcher]].
*Spawned by level 4 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when an [[Adapted Reeker]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Primitive Reekers are Fast moving Melee Combatants with a devastating AoE charge.

*Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, which inflicts Poison for 5 seconds.
*Primitive Reekers have a chance of blocking incoming damage, nullifying it.
*If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Primitive Reekers can perform the following abilities:
**Perform a charge attack. After staying still for some seconds, they'll charge forward. This attack inflicts very high damage per second, ignores immunity frames, and inflicts great knockback and AoE Damage.
***This is telegraphed by flame particles and a significantly louder and higher pitched growl. They will also stand still before performing this attack.
*Primitive Reekers can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
*Primitive Reekers can dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*On death, Primitive Reekers have a chance to explode, releasing Primitive Remains and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and COTH.
*Primitive Reekers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 1, with a 60 ticks cooldown and 1 Block range.
*If a Primitive Reeker gets 10 kills it will evolve into an [[Adapted Reeker]].
*If a Primitive Reeker is named "''Ricardo''" with a Name Tag, it will become differently textured, accompanied by a lightning strike sound.
**Note: The option to do this is disabled by default in the config file.
**If this renamed Reeker is sheared, it will become angry and be afflicted with [[Rage]].
{{Variants|count=4|Texture=PalePriReeker.png|TextureName=Pale|TextureDesc=inflicts double the damage but has half the HP.|Berserker=BerserkerPriReeker.png|Virulent=VirulentPriReeker.png|Breacher=BreacherPriReeker.png}}


=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Primitive Reekers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.{{Properties
|tier=Primitive
|OrbEffectsMobs=Hunger II (00:15), Nausea II (00:15)
}}

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* On death, Primitive Reekers have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Primitive Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|Call of the Hive]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Primitive Reekers will become [[Moving Flesh]] upon death instead.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Reekers are also known as '''Nogla''' in the Mod Files.
*The texture a Primitive Reeker named "''Ricardo''" has is a reference to the character of the same name from Limbus Company.
**Killing this renamed Reeker is the only way to obtain the [[Book of Vengeance]] and grants the {{AdvancementLink|TRICKED ME, DID YOU??!!}}, more references to Limbus Company.
